gen-fs-bevellier-gf-aldrich: Flat, stencil-cut strokes with barely any gap between glyphs give Bevellier its graceful edge. Aldrich takes over below with a tall x-height and rounded shapes that feel cupped rather than clenched.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-alexandria: Bevellier looks like it was cut from a single wire-thin line, with a wide-looking lowercase and squat ascenders. Alexandria follows as a clean sans, tall in the body with short stems and terminals left wide open.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla reads as contemporary and approachable, its wide s curves barely curling inward and its ascenders staying short. Bevellier does the showy work with constant-width arms and legs, and the sans simply does the steady reading.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-devanagari: Graceful and flat-cut, Bevellier draws tube-like lines of constant weight with its letters packed tight together. And Anek Devanagari, a sans with a tall middle zone and distinctly open mouths, gives the eye a roomier place to rest beneath it.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Bevellier is flat-cut and graceful, with no contrast anywhere. Its stems and joins match exactly, which is where it earns its keep when set big and short, while Anek Gurmukhi stays in the background as a plain sans.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-kannada: Blocky, tall, and wide open. Anek Kannada's high x-height feels like squared-off woodblock type, and its terminals stop well away from the stem, so a long stretch of it moves along steadily under Bevellier's pressure-free line.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-latin: Bevellier cuts every stroke to one measured thickness. That makes it a sophisticated choice for big, short lines, while Anek Latin, a plain sans with tall lowercase nearly reaching the capitals, holds its letters open below.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam is clean and contemporary. Its caps sit barely above the x-height, and Bevellier's stencil-cut single-width strokes sit above them, so the best thing about this pair is how flat and graceful it looks.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia reads clean and contemporary, with rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook and capitals only just above lowercase. Bevellier, by contrast, has no thick and thin parts in any letter, so it sits above the plain sans as a flat, stencil-cut sign.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-tamil: Modern and graceful, Bevellier keeps its strokes flat, with no modulation at all. Anek Tamil, a sans with big round bowls and c and s shapes that look half unwrapped, would read generously across a longer passage.
